_comment: FAMS Vue Agents configuration. Edit in git, then re-run deploy/install.sh. Read by scripts/devops.mjs.

git._comment: Tecmo branching model: master = production, development = integration (everything awaiting the next production build). Work branches are made from development. Agents may only create/push their OWN branches: agents_features/<issue>-<slug> or agents_bugfixes/<mon><yyyy>/<issue>-<slug> (mon = jan feb mar apr may jun jul aug sept oct nov dec, like the team's bugfixes/sept2024). PRs go into development only.

projects._comment: Where agreed Vue projects live (all inside the Fams24 repo for now): name -> {project, repo, path}. The Vue Lead asks before using a new folder.

allowed_repos._comment: The ONLY repos the agents may clone/branch/push/PR (Hennie, 6 Oct 2026: focus on Fams24 only). Add entries here to widen scope.
